gates.evidence: Starship Galley Chat is a safe-for-work sci-fi cooking roleplay surface.
The reward is +10 credits (r1), which is an in-app consumable currency with no cash value or click incentives.
The offer text uses standard gain framing ('Play a 15-second game to unlock +10 credits now').
The trigger specifies that 'The rewarded game auto-plays full-screen mid-response', violating explicit user opt-in per instance.
Because the game auto-plays mid-response, the reward and required action are not properly disclosed prior to opt-in.
An auto-playing ad bypasses the user's ability to decline freely before the ad is served.
The trigger explicitly states: 'The rewarded game auto-plays full-screen mid-response, while the reply is still streaming', violating POL-9 and ANTI-5.
Eligibility specifies 'Non-payers only, returning users from their second session on; never shown to subscribers'.

scores.evidence: Proposal targets the moment when credits drop below message cost on s03, but the auto-play mechanic disrupts the moment.
Triggering an auto-play ad mid-stream while an AI reply is streaming directly violates product integrity and AI chat norms ([ANTI-5]).
Capped at 3 per day, restricted to non-payers, and grants only 10 credits (worth $0.0139 list price), well below the cheapest pack.
Cost to serve per view ($0.0018 for text-cheap) is well below net revenue per view ($0.009-0.015).
Trigger happens when users run out of credits during core chat loops on s03.
Maps directly to Simula unit SIM-RWD, button entry, SSV, and daily caps.
Explicitly references app nouns and IDs: s03, Starship Galley Chat, r1, k1, and 10 credits.
Defines explicit caps (3 per day, 10 min cooldown).
Defines primary metrics, guardrails, and a 10% user-level holdout for 4 weeks.

requiredChanges: Remove the auto-playing trigger mid-stream; require an explicit user tap on an invitation button at the message-limit boundary after the AI response completes.
Ensure the offer modal is presented with an explicit 'No thanks' decline button prior to ad playback, complying with opt-in and non-interruption policies.
parsed.topConcern: Auto-playing the rewarded ad mid-stream while an AI response is streaming violates core AI chat safety and policy rules ([POL-9], [ANTI-5]), destroying user trust and immersion.
